citation: Josic J, Olsson AT, Wickeberg J, et al. Does green tea affect postprandial glucose, insulin and satiety in healthy subjects: a randomized controlled trial. Nutrition Journal. 2010;9:63.
protocol: Meal of 100 g white bread (50 g carbohydrate, 8 g protein, 3 g fat) plus 25 g smoked turkey (4.5 g protein, 0.75 g fat), with 300 mL water (reference) or 300 mL green tea, eaten within 10 min; crossover. Blood at 0, 15, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120 min.

reports.where: Table 1: cumulative insulin AUC at 0-15, 0-30, 0-45, 0-60, 0-90, 0-120 min per arm

note: A small carbohydrate-rich meal with exact grams; its cumulative AUC windows let a reader recover the shape of the early insulin curve. Use the water (reference) arm. Insulin is in mU·min/l. Only in figures: incremental insulin curve (Fig. 1). Meal kinds: mixed meal.
